purpose: Measure reviewer-interface operational duration, completion, technical interruption, and independent-role workflow feasibility before numerical design freeze, without collecting an outcome or semantic image judgement.
source_boundary: Use only included outcome-free measurement-feasibility pilot pairs that are permanently ineligible for both v2 confirmation samples. Exclude every canonical pair listed in the retired v1 rehearsal ledger.
prohibited_uses: Using a rehearsal response as a v2 reviewability label, reason, confidence, or adjudication outcome
Using a rehearsal pair in a development, calibration, mechanism, deployment, or confirmation sample
Selecting a model, threshold, Brier increment, or effect size from rehearsal content
Showing participants another participant's response or raw operational log
Treating operational-rehearsal completion as permission to launch v2 outcome collection
claim_boundary: A completed rehearsal may inform reviewer-workload and completion assumptions only. It does not establish human-label reliability, feature validity, model utility, identity performance, or a v2 outcome result.
